resolution.note: S29 rehearsal: adopt kept boilerplate-2026's own site skills; regression test red before, green after

title: krn adopt keeps a repository's own site skills instead of overwriting them with the pinned copy
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16 (krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac, log .krn/tmp/s29/adopt1.log).
Defect: krn adopt overwrites a repository's own site skill files (.agents/skills/{acf-component,cube-css,plesk-deploy,wp-runtime}) with the installer's pinned copy (src/adopt/site-skills, boilerplate commit 30778b5), deleting 82 lines of newer operator content. writeSkills in src/adopt/adopt.ts writes every file through writeIfChanged.
Outcome: a site skill the repository already has (its SKILL.md exists) is kept untouched and reported unchanged; core KRN skills still upgrade.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/adopt.test.ts: pass (an existing site skill with local edits survives adopt byte for byte).
